title: A Gift Wrapped in Sunrise
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A song-writer woke up one day,
The sun was shining bright,
The birds were singing, and his heart
Was full of joy and light.

[Chorus]
This is the day the Lord has made,
So I'll be glad today,
Each day's a gift from God to me,
His love will always stay.

[Verse 2]
Some days are big and full of fun,
Some days are quiet, small,
But each one is a gift from God,
Who's good and loves us all.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the sun has set,
Tomorrow's on its way,
A gift from God made just for you,
He's near you; rest till day.

[Chorus]
mood: Morning music. A light, waking sway with a soft lift at the start of each line, like sunlight and birdsong coming through a window, matching a story about a brand-new day made by God. The pulse is glad but never rushed, easy enough for a child to sway to. By the last verse it turns to evening, lower and slower, the lift settling into a calm rock toward tomorrow.
